0x000074.en:
God and the devil are at war,
and the battlefield is the heart of man.

0x000122.en:
After the Shura Rebellion ended, Lune took the
Valsione out toward the shoal zone to investigate
the movements of the Neue DC remnants.

0x0001DD.en:
A proximity alarm blared through the cockpit - and
the instant Lune confirmed the unknown craft,
something went very wrong.

0x000263.en:
Her vision suddenly went dark - a feeling of
being dragged into a bottomless abyss...

0x0002B9.en: And then her consciousness melted into the darkness...
